metadata.description: Local text to rigged 3D asset on an AMD Strix Halo iGPU

plugins.name: text-to-3d
plugins.description: Turns a sentence into a GLB that drops into three.js, fully local on a Strix Halo iGPU: FLUX.2 klein for the reference image, a Vulkan-only TRELLIS.2 engine for the mesh, a face-count target for game-ready low poly, and Blender headless for a measured skeleton with idle, walk, run and jump. Ships a turntable viewer and an MCP server that returns ids and preview URLs rather than bytes.
